arguments.summary: A network intrusion attempt was detected originating from host 10.0.12.10 (VLAN 40 - Engineering) targeting a low-criticality Ubuntu workstation (WS-IT-101, 10.0.2.15) in VLAN 20. The activity began with a SYN scan signature (ET SCAN Nmap SYN Scan), logged by IDS, and correlated with 23 SIEM events indicating a port scan. Although the scan was initially low-severity, follow-up actions revealed a compromised host. A full EPP scan detected 'Miner.CoinHive.A' malware. As a precaution, the associated service account (CORP\helpdesk) was reset, the source IP was blocked at the firewall, and the target system was hardened via Ansible. No evidence of lateral movement or data exfiltration was found.

timeline.description: IDS alert (ET SCAN Nmap SYN Scan) triggered by 10.0.12.10 scanning 10.0.2.15. Activity logged but not blocked.
SIEM correlation confirms 23 scan events from external source 192.168.1.100, proxied through 10.0.12.10. UEBA scores user anomaly as low risk.
Incident response initiated. Firewall rule (FW-RULE-0050) implemented to block inbound traffic from 10.0.12.10.
Full EPP scan of WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) detects cryptocurrency miner malware ('Miner.CoinHive.A') in /tmp directory.
Credentials for service account 'CORP\helpdesk' reset due to potential compromise. Secure re-enrollment initiated.
Ansible playbook 'harden-linux-workstation.yml' executed on WS-IT-101 to apply security baseline configurations.
Incident containment confirmed. No further malicious activity observed.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects configuration data from Cobalt Strike beacons"

        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"

        $cfg_uris = "/index.php" wide ascii
        $cfg_post_data = "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and all of them
}
